title: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in DELETE…
description: phpMyFAQ versions from 4.2.0-alpha.2 up to but not including 4.2.0-RC.2 have an authorization vulnerability in the DELETE /admin/api/faq/delete endpoint. This flaw allows FAQ_DELETE admins scoped to a specific language to bypass their language restrictions and delete data related to other language translations, including shared ACLs, tags, votes, comments, and attachments.
